purpose: Maintain a full operational campaign-world record while clearly separating original campaign canon from paused source reconstruction, unknown player-private facts, generated detail and historical evidence.
rules: Every domain has an explicit coverage state even when EMPTY/UNKNOWN.
Every unknown gets a GAP ID if it can affect gameplay continuity.
One fact has one authoritative home; other files point to it.
No maintenance task advances world time unless explicitly executing gameplay.
Historical/superseded evidence is archived, not silently rewritten away.
Generated filler must be reversible and cannot overwrite a stronger source/user fact.
A future source fact supersedes filler prospectively through a recorded migration.
Every promoted batch gets manifest, checksums, validation and Drive readback.
A generated local district may be READY for gameplay while the corresponding global/source domain remains PARTIAL.
Population records must distinguish generated filler residents from source-private or player characters.
Support infrastructure (utilities, sanitation, supply, security, transit, media) must be recorded rather than assumed invisible.
With explicit user authorization, ORIGINAL_CAMPAIGN_CANON may permanently close operational world gaps without pretending to be source/novel canon.
Source exactness and operational campaign completeness are separate axes; paused source reconstruction does not block an original-canon world baseline.
Player-private biography is not a world gap and is never auto-filled merely to make coverage metrics look complete.
Macro canon can mark a domain operationally READY while specific uninstantiated interiors/NPC biographies remain generated-before-use detail.
